name: Fossil Hunters
summary:
Fossil Hunters is a mixed reality game that takes you on a journey of dinosaur fossil excavations, assembly puzzles, and learning.

Embark on expeditions around the world to visit dig sites where you'll uncover fossil fragments of the mighty creatures that once roamed the Earth.

Use fun excavation tools to unearth fossil pieces and assemble them into complete skeletons.

Learn fascinating facts about dinosaurs as you progress on your adventure.

EARLY ACCESS
Please note, this is an early prototype. Mechani
